slide1.headline: Nvidia and Microsoft Launch AI Security Alliance
slide1.subtitle: A new initiative to improve AI security

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Nvidia and Microsoft launched an open AI security alliance on 27 Jul 2026
The alliance aims to improve AI security and transparency
16 companies have already joined the alliance

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The alliance will focus on developing standards for AI security
This initiative will help to build trust in AI systems

slide1.headline: Indian Startups Raise Over $163 Million in Funding
slide1.subtitle: A significant increase in funding for Indian startups

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: 16 Indian startups raised over $163 million in funding between July 20 and July 25, 2026
The funding was raised from investors across various sectors
The startups that received funding are from diverse sectors such as Healthtech, Fintech, and Edtech

lines: The funding will help the startups to expand their operations and develop new products
It demonstrates the growing interest of investors in the Indian startup ecosystem
